mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.0% signals restrictive monetary policy that increases corporate borrowing costs, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strength in housing starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (HOUST * RSAFS) has Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes (low unemployment and strong labor market), the S&P 500 underperforms as the Federal Reserve initiates rate hikes to prevent overheating, leading to negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of late-cycle expansion periods.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in industrial production (INDPRO) signals robust manufacturing activity, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate increase above 5.5% signals labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.5%.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL) combined with a low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates inadequate monetary policy response, creating real rate uncertainty and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (CPIAUCSL * FEDFUNDS) has Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In early-cycle expansion regimes (rising housing starts), the S&P 500 experiences positive forward returns as housing activity drives economic growth and corporate earnings momentum over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of early-cycle expansion periods.
